mapper.sql: m.id, m.project_id, m.account_id, m.invited_by, m.joined_at, m.left_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM project_member m WHERE m.project_id = #{projectId} AND m.account_id = #{accountId} AND m.left_at IS NULL

SELECT , a.name AS account_name, a.email AS account_email, a.tier AS account_tier, a.job AS account_job FROM project_member m JOIN account a ON a.id = m.account_id WHERE m.project_id = #{projectId} AND m.left_at IS NULL ORDER BY a.tier, CASE a.job WHEN 'pm' THEN 0 WHEN 'planner' THEN 1 WHEN 'designer' THEN 2 WHEN 'developer' THEN 3 WHEN 'qa' THEN 4 ELSE 9 END, a.name
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_member WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND account_id = #{accountId} AND left_at IS NULL )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_member (project_id, account_id, invited_by, joined_at) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{accountId}, #{invitedBy}, now())
mapper.update: UPDATE project_member SET left_at = now() WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND account_id = #{accountId} AND left_at IS NULL
